title: Calls on the chat server: records, liveness, history lines, missed calls
spec: docs/CALLS.md 'Call records and liveness'. FEATURE_CALLS (64); requests 18 CallStart { room, video }, 19 CallJoin, 20 CallHeartbeat, 21 CallLeave { room, call }, each answered Ok with the call id; E_NO_SUCH_CALL (11). A room has at most one open call: CallStart joins it when there is one; otherwise a member who may post starts one (a Guest or an archive room: NotAllowed). History lines are EventKind::CallLine events ('started a call'; 'call ended after <duration>: <everyone who joined>'), never unread. A person with no heartbeat for HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS (75 s) leaves at their last heartbeat (sweep_calls, run on every durable receive and call request); an empty call ends at that time. A heartbeat or leave for a call the person is not in is NoSuchCall; removal from the room takes them out of the call at once and later requests are NotMember. Records CallStart/CallJoin/CallLeave/CallEnd (tags 25-28) are replayed; heartbeats are not journaled. missed_calls(user): ended calls in rooms they are still in, started by someone else after they joined the room, never joined by them, newest end first. After Sync a client with FEATURE_CALLS gets CallState (the open call, before the events) and CallLine (push 75; Other for older clients); the inbox keeps RoomView::call (cleared by the end line) and call_lines. The network server advertises FEATURE_CALLS. The memory backend answers call requests E_NO_STORAGE.
